anomalies.description: A physical fight erupts: the man in the gray shirt initiates with a punch toward the bald man in black (f11), who blocks or is struck (f12–f13); then multiple men converge and tackle the gray-shirted man to the ground (f14–f15).
A group of men engage in a violent street fight involving punches, grappling, and takedowns; multiple participants are seen striking and overpowering others across the sequence.
After being taken down, one man lies on the ground while others continue to strike and pin him, indicating targeted assault on a helpless victim.
A man in a black sleeveless shirt engages in close-quarters combat with an opponent in white pants; visible punches and grappling occur, culminating in the opponent being thrown to the ground.

A second fight sequence involving a man in a red tank top and white headband being struck and thrown by a bald man in black; includes a high-impact takedown and the red-shirted man landing on his back.
A third combat interaction: a man in black throws another man (wearing black tank top and white pants) through the air; the victim lands hard on the pavement, indicating a forceful takedown.
A man is lying on his back, restrained and helpless, while another man stabs a basketball he is holding with a knife; the victim has visible facial injuries and appears incapacitated.
